name: dataset/migrations/__init__.py
summary: Package initializer for the dataset application migrations directory.
purpose: Makes the migrations directory a Python package so Django can discover, import, and manage database migration modules for the dataset app.
responsibilities: Mark the migrations directory as a Python package
Enable Django's migration framework to locate and load migration files within the dataset app
architecture_notes: Standard Django architectural pattern requiring __init__.py in every migrations directory. This file is typically empty and serves solely as a package marker for Python's import system. It allows Django's migration loader to traverse the package, identify migration modules, and build the migration dependency graph for the dataset app.
improvements: Add a module-level docstring documenting the package purpose if organizational standards require explicit documentation
Ensure the file is committed to version control to guarantee the migrations directory exists in deployments
Avoid placing custom logic in this file to prevent side effects during Django's migration discovery process
